$comment: p15-oracle-095: e2e scripts 34-44 of MQ-e2e (`ls scripts/cmux-next/*-e2e.py scripts/cmux-next/*-e2e.sh`, sorted) at `queue_ref`, the perf/chrome-parity commit the batches were assigned from (66 scripts; the test lists that commit's tree, not the working tree, so scripts added later do not move the batch), each converted to a case of this suite or excluded with a reason (p15-oracle.md section 5, item 4). The scripts stay; each case's first step names its script. `fix` is the commit that made the behavior the case checks, `parent` that commit's parent: the case's acceptance is a Failure (or a Timeout of its wait) on `parent`. `catches` names the step (before the colon) that should show the bug there; `catches: null` means the case cannot see one, and `gap` says why. One file per batch, as _scripts-093.json and _scripts-094.json, so the batches (092-097) never edit the same file; oracle.py skips `_` files.
red_on_parent: not run: each parent predates the debug.oracle.* methods (they came with e0c736692e5, 2026-10-26), so driver_app refuses the launch (no-oracle-methods) before the first step. The fleet runs each case on its parent with oracle.py diff --overlay once p15-oracle-202 lands; until then `catches` is the expected failing step, which scripts/cmux-next/oracle/e2e_095_cases_test.py checks against a fake of the parent behavior, not an observed run.

scripts/cmux-next/pane-edge-drop-e2e.py.excluded: drags a tab with debug.mouse at hand pace (one move per display frame for 0.7 s) to another pane's bottom edge and reads the strips (debug.tab_drag) and pane borders (debug.pane_chrome): case-v1 has no pointer step; the split the drop makes is the layout facet's once one exists

scripts/cmux-next/pane-localapp-e2e.py.excluded: starts a real acpmux daemon (a Rust binary, run on a Testbox) and checks the origin it reports for WebSocket connections with and without the LocalApp token: no cmux app is launched, so no app-driver step or app facet applies; it belongs with the acpmux daemon tests

scripts/cmux-next/pane-tab-bar-e2e.py.catches: retired-setting: on the parent tabs.tabBar.agent is a schema key whose choices include never, so settings set succeeds and the expected error does not come
scripts/cmux-next/pane-tab-bar-e2e.py.gap: whether a pane's tab bar shows and the toggle's Hide / Show title: no facet records them (debug.pane_chrome only), so the case's other steps check only that the actions run

scripts/cmux-next/passkeys-matrix-e2e.py.excluded: serves the test relying party and runs WebAuthn ceremonies through browser.page.eval, each with a DevTools virtual authenticator (debug.cef.devtools), in CEF and WebKit tabs: case-v1 has no page-eval or DevTools step, driver_app has no web fixture yet (fixture.web, p15-oracle-222), and no facet records a ceremony's result

scripts/cmux-next/passkeys-roaming-e2e.p.excluded: registers and signs in on https://webauthn.io, a real relying party over the network, with virtual roaming authenticators, and its --real mode needs a person with a security key or phone: oracle cases are offline (section 3D)

scripts/cmux-next/picker-e2e.py.excluded: launches its own app, builds a folder tree at /tmp/r89-picker-fixture and types into the palette panel (debug.key target palette), reading the picker's page path and selection from each key's reply: driver_app builds no file fixture, a case's key reaches only the focused pane, and the overlays facet hashes the query and has no picker page path

scripts/cmux-next/pinned-items-e2e.py.gap: 29f4f8389f4 (the script's commit) changed only the main menu's Pin / Unpin Workspace titles, which no facet records; the pinned-tab rules the case checks (a pinned tab first, Close Other Tabs keeps it) come from the first CmuxNextTabs strip (c433bf50bf6) and no later fix changed them, so no parent shows a bug this case sees.
